description: This file is a Makefile defining kernel modules and packages for a Linux-based system, specifically for the OpenWrt project. It specifies multiple kernel modules related to video and display functionalities for Broadcom BCM2835 and Raspberry Pi hardware, including camera interfaces, display panels, codecs, and graphics drivers. The file primarily contains macro definitions, package descriptions, dependencies, file references, and auto-loading instructions.

classes.name: KernelPackage/camera-bcm2835
classes.description: Camera host interface devices for Broadcom BCM2835 SoC.

classes.name: KernelPackage/rp1-cfe
classes.description: Driver for the Camera Serial Interface (CSI) to capture video streams from connected cameras.

classes.name: KernelPackage/rpi-panel-attiny-regulator
classes.description: Driver for the ATTINY regulator on the Raspberry Pi 7-inch touchscreen unit.

classes.name: KernelPackage/rpi-panel-7inch-touchscreen
classes.description: Driver for the Raspberry Pi 7" Touchscreen.

classes.name: KernelPackage/codec-bcm2835
classes.description: V4L2 video codecs for Broadcom BCM2835 SoC.

classes.name: KernelPackage/drm-vc4
classes.description: Direct Rendering Manager support for VideoCore IV GPU in BCM2835 and related SoCs.

classes.name: KernelPackage/isp-bcm2835
classes.description: V4L2 driver for the Broadcom BCM2835 ISP hardware.

classes.name: KernelPackage/vc-sm-cma
classes.description: Shared Memory (CMA) driver supporting sharing of dmabufs with VideoCore.

classes.name: KernelPackage/vchiq-mmal-bcm2835
classes.description: Enables MMAL API over VCHIQ for multimedia services on VideoCore.

classes.name: KernelPackage/drm-rp1-dsi
classes.description: Manages the DSI interface for high-resolution LCD panels on RP1 platform.

classes.name: KernelPackage/drm-rp1-dpi
classes.description: Controls the parallel RGB interface (DPI) for LCD display output on RP1.

classes.name: KernelPackage/drm-rp1-vec
classes.description: Supports composite video output via RCA jack, for connecting old TVs or monitors.
